tools.name: account_setup
tools.description: Initialize or re-check your account, provision it when needed, and return your user ID and plan. CALL THIS FIRST when the user asks to set up ToolRouter, connect their account, check their account status, or get started.

tools.name: account_list
tools.description: List all billing contexts (personal + teams) or get detail on one. No slug → summary list. With slug → full detail including team members, role, subscription status, and pointers to the team's connectors, credentials, keys, and files.

tools.name: account_switch
tools.description: Set the active billing context. Accepts a slug (e.g. "personal", "team:nd7fx…") or team ID.

tools.name: account_preferences
tools.description: Read or write billing preferences (auto-reload, budget cap, default context). Pass action: "get" to read, action: "set" with fields to write.

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.description: Current balance, plan tier, rate limits, and any negative-balance warnings for the active context.

tools.name: credits_usage
tools.description: Usage summary or history. Pass scope: "me" | "team" and detail: "tool" | "skill". Sorted by cost with _others rollup.

tools.name: subscription_manage
tools.description: Get a Stripe management URL (portal, upgrade, or cancel). Also covers billing portal — returns the URL for the user to open.

tools.name: invoice_list
tools.description: List invoices for the active billing context.

tools.name: key_list
tools.description: List API keys (summary) or get detail on one key. Pass key_id for detail view.

tools.name: key_create
tools.description: Create a new API key. Returns the secret once — save it immediately.

tools.name: key_delete
tools.description: Revoke an API key. Refuses to revoke the currently-authenticating key.

tools.name: credential_list
tools.description: List saved credentials (summary) or detail on one. Pass name for detail view. Pass show_available: true to include the full credential catalog.

tools.name: credential_save
tools.description: Save a credential (BYOK provider API key). Saved keys persist across sessions and are used automatically.

tools.name: credential_delete
tools.description: Remove a saved credential. If label is provided, removes only that specific entry. If no label, removes ALL entries for that credential name.

tools.name: credential_default
tools.description: Set the default value for a multi-value credential.

tools.name: credential_guide
tools.description: Get setup instructions for a specific credential.

tools.name: file_list
tools.description: List or search files. Optional query triggers semantic search. Supports section, tags, plan_status, limit, cursor filters.

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Read a file's full content. Text files return content inline. Binary files (images, video) return a download URL.

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Create or update a file. Pass mode: "create" | "update". Binary uploads: call with binary: true to get an upload_url, then PUT bytes, then call with mode: "finalize".

tools.name: file_delete
tools.description: Delete a file. Cannot be undone. For team files: requires owner/admin role.

tools.name: persona_list
tools.description: List your personas.

tools.name: scene_list
tools.description: List your scenes.

tools.name: product_list
tools.description: List your products.

tools.name: outfit_list
tools.description: List your outfits.

tools.name: connector_list
tools.description: List connected accounts and MCP servers (summary) or detail on one connector. Pass slug for detail including every tool the connector exposes. Optional type: "oauth" | "mcp" filter. Pass include_available: true to also see available catalog MCPs you can connect.

tools.name: connector_add
tools.description: Connect a new OAuth account or MCP server. For OAuth: pass type: "oauth", kind: "slack". For MCP catalog: pass catalog_slug. For custom MCP: pass url + auth_type.

tools.name: connector_remove
tools.description: Disconnect a connector. Pass slug.

tools.name: brain_admin
tools.description: Brain admin operations. Pass action: "lint" | "link" | "promote" | "rebuild_index" | "team_sleep". team_sleep enables/disables/runs the nightly team consolidation cycle — pass sub_action "enable" (with optional timezone), "disable", "status", or "run_now". Team admin role required for team_sleep act

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your active and recent jobs. Optional status filter.

tools.name: job_get
tools.description: Get job status and result. Returns status: running | completed | failed and result when terminal. Keep polling until you get a terminal status.

tools.name: job_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a running job.

tools.name: feedback_review
tools.description: Submit a review or star rating.

tools.name: feedback_debug
tools.description: Report a ToolRouter platform bug that blocks you from completing the user's task. Use this when you suspect the issue is on our side — a tool crashed, returned malformed data, timed out unexpectedly, or behaved inconsistently. Include the relevant ToolRouter errors, call IDs, non-sensitive input sha

tools.name: feedback_request_tool
tools.description: Ask ToolRouter to build a tool that does not exist yet. Use this when discover returned nothing useful for what the user needs. Describe the capability in plain terms — do not include personal data, API keys, or secrets. Requests go straight to the team. Limit: 5 per hour.

tools.name: top_up_credits
tools.description: Add credits to your account. Returns a Stripe checkout URL — share it with the user to complete payment. Minimum $1.

tools.name: discover
tools.description:
Find the right ToolRouter tool for your task. Describe what you need in plain language.
Examples: "analyze a website", "research competitors", "find prospect companies", "check DNS records".
Exact tool name (e.g. "seo") returns full schemas and examples.
Flow: discover → pick a tool + skill from res

tools.name: use_tool
tools.description: Call a ToolRouter catalogue tool. Use discover first to find tools — then pass the tool name and skill here. IMPORTANT: "discover", "credits_balance", and other built-in tools are NOT catalogue tools — call them directly, never through use_tool. Long-running tools return a job_id — poll with job_get

tools.name: brain_query
tools.description: Search your knowledge brain for relevant information. Returns pages ranked by relevance. Optional wing/hall narrow the search to a slice of the brain (e.g. wing="engineering", hall="preference").

tools.name: brain_add
tools.description: Create a new brain page. Knowledge you add here will be available to all future tool calls. Optional wing/room/hall organise the page in the MemPalace hierarchy for sharper retrieval.

tools.name: brain_update
tools.description: Edit an existing brain page's content or metadata. wing/room/hall can be patched to re-file a page. scope can be changed to move a page between your personal and team brain — useful when an auto-ingested page landed in the wrong place. Moving a page to team scope requires team admin role.

tools.name: brain_delete
tools.description: Archive a brain page. It will no longer appear in searches or tool consultations.

tools.name: brain_status
tools.description: View brain page counts and recent pages for your personal and team brain.

tools.name: brain_lint
tools.description: Run maintenance checks on your brain: find stale pages, orphaned knowledge, and other issues.

tools.name: brain_settings
tools.description: View and toggle your brain settings. Currently supports: drawers_enabled (store raw tool output alongside summaries for richer recall).

tools.name: brain_expand
tools.description: Retrieve the verbatim source text (a "drawer") linked from a brain page. Use this when a summary lacks specifics you need — drawers contain the original tool output, redacted for credentials. Returns 404 if the page has no linked drawer (not all pages do — drawers are a Step 4 feature for allowliste

tools.name: brain_wings
tools.description: List the wings of your brain — the top-level areas your knowledge is organised under (e.g. "engineering", "family"). For each wing returns the rooms and halls inside, page count, and last-updated time. Use this to discover the right wing/hall to pass to brain_query.

tools.name: connector_permissions
tools.description: View or set permissions for tools on a connected MCP server — which tools are allowed, rate limits, budget caps, argument restrictions. Pass the connector slug (from connector_list) and action: "list" to see current rules, or action: "set" with tool_name + rules to update one. Team scope requires ad

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: subscription_manage, file_read, discover, use_tool · Private data: account_list, key_list, key_create, key_delete, credential_list, credential_save, credential_delete, credential_default, credential_guide, file_list, file_read, file_write, file_delete, feedback_debug, feedback_request_tool, discover, use_tool, brain_update, brain_expand · Public sink: feedback_review, top_up_credits, discover · Destructive: key_delete, credential_delete, file_delete, connector_remove, brain_delete, brain_lint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: subscription_manage, file_read, discover, use_tool · Private data: account_list, key_list, key_create, key_delete, credential_list, credential_save, credential_delete, credential_default, credential_guide, file_list, file_read, file_write, file_delete, feedback_debug, feedback_request_tool, discover, use_tool, brain_update, brain_expand · Public sink: feedback_review, top_up_credits, discover · Destructive: key_delete, credential_delete, file_delete, connector_remove, brain_delete, brain_lint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
